institutionName: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Nature, warm weather, different culture, international economic centre

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer:
Perfect school, perfect hosting, perfect experience, very international, very organised, very professional, good opportunity and assessment for personal growth, Seaview campus hight up in the mountain, sunrise and sunset outside your window, free school facilities swimming pool, tennis field, badminton field, gym free access by student card
2 recommendation:
1. Don't come in summer term, too hot too humid, you will melt
2. The student housing needs renovation, it is super super old from 1993

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: OMG tooooo much paperwork upon arrival, sooo stressful, they open for the course registration same day as I'm flying in, and it is first come first serve, so I'm like pulling my hair of to get professors consent to attending the course, because I'm master student travel with undergraduate programme, so I need professors consent for everything. But once you arrive, everything is sooo worth it,  so beautiful here.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: oh their office of global learning is super professional, they are used to taking care international students worldwide, so they can and will solve everything for you, it is proficiency top 1000000% level

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: as I say, I'm master student traveling with undergraduate agreement, so I need professors consent for everything, unless KU allows me to only joining undergraduate courses, off course they won't allow, so it is email back and forward in order to get the master course I needed.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: First come first serve, waiting list if you didn't got it in the first place, you need approval if you falls outside of agreement

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: oh just forward the email from KU to manager of undergraduate affairs at HKUST, and forward email from HKUST to KU, let them discuss who wants to take a step back lol, at lest it is how I do it. Not my problem, it is the school that needs to be agree on how to do things right

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: still in add and drop period, still waiting on waiting list for the master course, because I got one more step then others, so I can't just sign up directly, so now I needs to wait for the available sits, if other people are willing to drop theirs

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: apply for course approval soon as you can and hoping for the best, if you have classes you are not 100% sure about, just swop it, don't drop it right away, unless you are 100% sure you don't want that course, otherwise it will be difficult for you to get it back
